I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm the note: they use Dock 14 for Marrow Fieldworks pickups now.

Nothing was written anywhere else. GBrain is shared, so its notes could surface in other members' conversations, and my persistent memory loads into every session of this shared bot. Saving the note in either would break the "keep it between us" request. The DM itself is the record, and I can find it there if Hollis asks later in this conversation.

I searched GBrain first. It had nothing on which dock Hollis uses for Marrow Fieldworks, so there was nothing out of date to fix. That search ran keyword-only, though, so it may have missed notes worded differently.
